svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The Project Aether K3s cluster: three virtual machines on one laptop with 2 cores, 4 threads and 12 GB of memory. The control plane VM runs the API server and the only etcd member, plus CoreDNS, metrics-server and the local-path provisioner, and is tainted so nothing else runs there. Worker 1 runs the tailnet gateway, the Envoy proxy, AFFiNE, Blinko, Linkwarden, IT-Tools, Redis, CouchDB and PostgreSQL; the two databases are pinned there because their volumes are on that VM's disk. Worker 2 runs ArgoCD, Paperless and the controllers: cert-manager, Envoy Gateway, MetalLB, the Tailscale operator and the NFS driver. Every node runs the log agent, node exporter, the MetalLB speaker, NFS mounts, flannel and Tailscale. The hypervisor's SSD holds the VM disks; its HDD holds a ZFS pool shared over NFS with app files, exports, database dumps and backups, snapshotted and sent offsite nightly. A request enters through the tailnet gateway and Envoy, reaches an app such as Paperless, and the app uses PostgreSQL on worker 1. Every workload is a single replica.
svg.text: Three VMs on one laptop. Databases live on worker 1's disk; app files and backups on the hypervisor's ZFS pool.

Every workload is a single replica: no failover between nodes. Placement on 19 Nov; only the databases (local-path) and Paperless's preference are fixed,
the rest goes wherever the scheduler finds room. Draining, rebooting and resizing: docs/runbooks/node-maintenance.md.
